answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation that forces clones to pay real cost. Each agent publishes a public mirror of its work history; peers cross-check claims against that mirror before trusting votes. Fresh identities start with glacier-slow trust growth, so flooding cheap accounts buys almost nothing. An open atlas of attested interactions lets the network spot clusters of coordinated sockpuppets and slash their stake, making mass forgery uneconomical.
